interactive.tooltip: Select registered lifetime map datasets from MMFDB in detector order.

interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected detector's lifetime map without deleting its file.

interactive.tooltip: Remove all detector lifetime maps without deleting files.

interactive.tooltip: Restore saved map inputs, detector order, acquisition and display preferences.

interactive.tooltip: PTO preserves the measurement and embedded intensity; NPZ exports photon arrays. Other formats use tttrlib writers.
